name: care_heart_cohort
title: Adult Patients with Cardiology Encounters (Inpatient or Outpatient) After First Heart Failure Diagnosis
description: This cohort includes cardiology-related inpatient admissions and outpatient visits of patients with heart failure. An encounter is included when the patient is 18 years or older at the start of the encounter and their first heart failure diagnosis occurred on or before the encounter reference time: the discharge date for inpatient admissions and the visit date for outpatient visits.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

entry.name: patientEncounter
entry.description: Includes inpatient and outpatient hospital encounters associated with cardiology services.

eligibility.name: adultsWithHeartFailure
eligibility.description: Restricts the cohort to encounters of patients who are 18 years or older at the start of the encounter and whose first heart failure diagnosis occurred on or before the encounter reference time (discharge date for inpatient encounters, visit date for outpatient encounters).

criteria.name: adults
criteria.description: Include only patients who are 18 years or older at the start of the encounter.

criteria.name: firstHeartFailureDiagnosisBeforeReferenceTime
criteria.description: The patient’s first heart failure diagnosis must occur on or before the encounter reference time: the discharge date for inpatient encounters and the visit date for outpatient encounters.

period.description: Includes all patients for the defined cohort population.
